history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young East Asian woman with long, dark hair is captured in a close-up portrait. She is wearing a camouflage-patterned hoodie with the hood up, and a black baseball cap with white lettering, partially obscuring her forehead. Her eyes are wide and looking directly at the camera with a slightly mischievous expression. She has dramatic winged eyeliner. A lit cigarette is held horizontally between her lips, with the glowing ember visible. The background is somewhat blurred, suggesting an indoor setting with neutral-colored walls. To the left, a framed picture or artwork is visible on the wall, and a green sign with some text is also present. The lighting is somewhat dim, casting soft shadows and highlighting her facial features. The color palette is dominated by muted tones of gray, black, and the earthy hues of the camouflage pattern, with the warm glow of the cigarette ember providing a small contrasting point of light. The overall mood is edgy and confident, with a hint of rebellion.
